errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с приходи в трилиони долари
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The units "trillion dollars" apply only to the blue area chart (B2B market), as indicated by the legend. The orange line represents growth in percent (%), which is a different unit.
The blue visual representation is an area chart, not a bar chart ("стълбовидна графика").
The chart shows the first data point for the orange line is 10% in the year 2018, not 2017. There is no data point for growth in 2017.
The value for growth decreases from 10% in 2018 to 9% in 2019. The description incorrectly states that it increases ("нараства").

errors.text_span: Линията се издига постепенно нагоре по оста Y през целия период.
errors.evidence: This is a completely incorrect description of the trend for the orange line. The line fluctuates: it decreases from 2018 to 2019, increases until 2021, and then decreases again until 2023. It does not rise gradually throughout the entire period.
